    def solve(S):
        n = len(S)
        max_length = -1

        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                P = S[i:j]
                valid = True
                for k in range(1, len(P) + 1):
                    if S.startswith(P[:k]) or S.endswith(P[:k]):
                        valid = False
                        break
                if valid:
                    max_length = max(max_length, len(P))

        return max_length

    T, test_cases = read_input()
    results = [solve(S) for S in test_cases]

    for result in results:
        print(result)
